answer: Each submission hangs on the garden of a task receipt, and the nebula is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, forfeited on duplicate submission, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. By the raven of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce.
